descByPlatform.chatgpt: Extreme Close-Up Food Product Photograph for COCOA NOIR 85% Dark Chocolate launch hero. Subject: hand-broken 85% dark chocolate bar with crisp conchoidal fracture faces #3B2418, one unbroken embossed square carrying 'COCOA NOIR 85%' 6pt sans-serif relief, scattered cocoa powder drift 2cm at 7 o'clock, four whole cacao nibs clustered at 4 o'clock, single shard standing 38° catching rim. Setting: polished dark Carrara Marble slate #0E0E10 with faint vein streaks. Composition: Rule of Thirds unbroken square at 33% x 33% y, Centered 50% x 54% y overall, Bird's Eye 82° overhead, product 54% of frame. Camera: Phase One XF IQ4 150MP, Schneider 120mm LS Macro at f/11, 1/160s, ISO 50, tripod, focus-stacked 7 frames. Lighting: Softbox Studio Side Lighting + Rim Lighting — 4×6ft softbox camera-left 40° elevation 1.3m (key), 1×3ft strip rim camera-right 25° grazing fracture faces 0.9m (rim), 4×4ft white bounce camera-front 0.7m (fill), 4×4ft black flag overhead to deepen slate. Material physics: chocolate conchoidal fracture specular, cocoa powder matte scatter, cacao nib oil sheen, marble sub-surface shimmer. Color grade: Capture One Warm-10 LUT grain 8 +0.0 EV. Palette: chocolate brown 52%, slate black 30%, cocoa dust 10%, nib highlight 5%, rim light 3%. References: David Loftus food, Bea Lubas chocolate, Kinfolk still life. Exclude: melted smears, flat lighting, plastic sheen, cluttered props, colour cast.
